mintAuthority.summary: MoonPay issuance uses a mutable IssuerGateway, while the earner manager can configure rewards and mint outside the gateway queue. Ethereum, Arbitrum, Monad and Base share an issuer admin and token ProxyAdmin owner. Gateway delay is 300 seconds, not a financial issuance cap. The fifth native deployment on 0G has a different single-key administrator, which also owns its token and gateway upgrades. All five native stocks must be read for complete supply.
mintAuthority.headline: Issuer-controlled minting and upgrades remain outside the gateway delay; independent reserve reconciliation and signing safeguards are undisclosed.

review.evidence: Pinned 2026-10-15 observations: Ethereum 26197396 at 10:44:23Z, Arbitrum 515035868 at 10:44:30Z, Monad 113592531 at 10:44:30Z and Base 52635861 at 10:44:29Z. Complete Etherscan token RoleGranted/RoleRevoked histories on Ethereum, Arbitrum and Monad still contain 17 events each, retaining sole admin/rate-limit manager 0x314160525f5ea6677d3908112ff9bd885f3bb78e and exactly IssuerGateway plus Portal as issuer-role members. Independent RPC confirms current roles, earner manager, ProxyAdmin owner, implementations and no-code issuer on all four. Base complete pinned RPC history from pre-deployment block 50000000 through 52635861 independently returns 17 token permission events and the same issuer-role census; the complete token/Portal/gateway/adapter permission inventory returns 35 events. Gateway OPERATOR_ROLE and EXECUTOR_ROLE on all four chains resolve to separately identified no-code address 0x6017927a1375ce8962116ecda22acda4a345403a. Gateway ProxyAdmin 0x63df2057c740d6369a003e040a7abdf40a2d82fd is owned by the same issuer admin on all four, so gateway implementation replacement is another issuance bypass. All four gateway delays remain 300 seconds and TTLs 10800 seconds. Gateway buckets permit 25 million-token bursts and 12500 tokens/second. The issuer reward bucket is unconfigured on Ethereum and 5 million tokens with 2500 tokens/second refill on the other three; role/admin powers can change these limits. 0G block 47207217 at 10:44:28Z has 7 PYUSDx, not zero, and different administrator/earner-manager/ProxyAdmin owner 0xf2f1acbe0ba726fee8d75f3e32900526874740bb. A complete 0G role census resolves gateway and Portal issuer roles; its native controls and supply are included by this coordinated five-chain integration. Legal terms section 13 and the Enterprise disclosure still expressly describe local PYUSDx issuance as unregulated. Affiliate licences and Paxos supervision do not establish local prudential supervision, reserve reconciliation or issuer-key safeguards. Keyless RPC URLs and complete method/results are retained in the batch review ledger and research records. The scalar upgradeability summary binds only the Ethereum native token and its Ethereum upgrade-only control. Separate chain-qualified proxy-admin controls carry token/gateway upgrade reach for Arbitrum, Monad and Base; the 0G control is bound separately to its different owner. The scalar reference is representative, not an assertion that the Ethereum account administers every deployment.
